items.title: Isaiah "Ike" Robinson Interview, 1961-04-28
items.q: the fella down on the car that he was pretty fair reader. He taught me. Was that Banks? Yeah.

ctx.x: With a shield table, trombone, a fellow by the name of Bud Green. He was on drums. Joe Banks was on cornet. Little Willie, well, he was playing clarinet in our band at them times. And I was guitar. And a little fellow by the name of Alfred Dixon. He was playing bass.
